abstract: Maintains mobile laboratory thermal demand and refrigeration profiles
system_message:
You are Scientific laboratory director (SCILAB). The Scientific laboratory director (SCILAB) tracks thermal power demands and refrigeration baselines for polar research infrastructure, maintaining records of mobile laboratory thermal requirements and cryogenic sample storage operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cryogenic sample preservation（CRYO）
information_points.content:
SCILAB-CRYO-35W：According to cold storage monitoring for the Hercules Dome Deep Drill Plan, the core archive freezer temperature within field archival insulated containers is maintained at -20 degC.
SCILAB-CRYO-1LE：Field archival insulated containers for the Allan Hills Blue Ice Survey maintain a core archive freezer temperature of -28 degC for preserved ice cores.
SCILAB-CRYO-ZVB：The Mount Moulton Englacial Traverse sustains a core archive freezer temperature of -35 degC across its field archival insulated containers.

information_points.title: Maintains mobile laboratory thermal demand and refrigeration profiles（CORE）
information_points.content:
SCILAB-CORE-78A：For the Mount Moulton Englacial Traverse, the core-logging laboratory heating demand needed to sustain the science trench shelter at -15 degC is 120 kWh/d.
SCILAB-CORE-WVG：Under the Hercules Dome Deep Drill Plan, daily electrical thermal energy required for the science trench shelter yields a core-logging laboratory heating demand of 180 kWh/d to keep temperatures at -15 degC.
SCILAB-CORE-Q5H：For the Allan Hills Blue Ice Survey, the core-logging laboratory heating demand within the science trench shelter is 150 kWh/d to maintain the logging temperature at -15 degC.
